175	    // MARK: - Kind → sections
176	
177	    /// The active sub-tab's sections, in the handoff's order. A section that
178	    /// does not apply is absent rather than disabled — the pane is rebuilt
179	    /// when the selection's kinds or the tab change, so there is nothing
180	    /// stale to grey out.
181	    ///
182	    /// Picture exists only for a selection with PIXELS: every control in it
183	    /// writes a `set_video` patch, and `InspectorBinding` addresses those to
184	    /// the clips that draw.
185	    override func makeSections() -> [InspectorSection] {
186	        let hasPixels = !binding.videoClips.isEmpty
187	        var sections: [InspectorSection] = []
188	        switch activeSubTab {
189	        case .text:
190	            sections = [
191	                textPane.contentSection(), textPane.fontSection(), textPane.styleSection(),
192	                textPane.outlineSection(), textPane.backdropSection(), textPane.boxSection(),
193	                textPane.animationSection(), textPane.presetSection(),
194	            ]
195	        case .shape:
196	            sections = [
197	                shapePane.shapeSection(), shapePane.strokeSection(), shapePane.fillSection(),
198	                // Immediately after Fill, because a gradient REPLACES a fill
199	                // when it is set and the two rows are read together.
200	                shapePane.gradientSection(), shapePane.arrowSection(),
201	            ]
202	        case .graphic:
203	            sections = [graphicPane.sourceSection()]
204	            if graphicPane.shared() != nil { sections.append(graphicPane.propertiesSection()) }
205	            sections.append(graphicPane.sizeSection())
206	            if binding.isSingle, let clip = binding.primary {
207	                sections.append(graphicPane.timelineSection(clip.id))
208	            }
209	        case .picture:
210	            sections = [videoPane.transformSection()]
211	            // Behind Subject right after Transform (road map creator-jobs CO5, CO-55).
212	            if videoPane.allBehindable { sections.append(videoPane.behindSubjectSection()) }
213	            // Layout after Behind Subject, before Crop (road map creator-jobs CO7, CO-71).
214	            if videoPane.allLayoutable { sections.append(videoPane.layoutSection(layoutState)) }
215	            if videoPane.allHideable { sections.append(videoPane.hideSilentSection()) }  // CO-94
216	            // `allSourcePixels` asks about the SOURCE KIND, so it says yes to
217	            // an audio-only file's clip too; the tab itself is what keeps a
218	            // crop off a clip that draws nothing.
219	            if videoPane.allSourcePixels {
220	                sections += [
221	                    videoPane.cropSection(), videoPane.cornerSection(), videoPane.chromaSection(),
222	                ]
223	                // Background right after Chroma Key (road map creator-jobs CO3, CO-30 (a)).
224	                if videoPane.allCutoutable { sections.append(videoPane.cutoutSection(cutoutMemo)) }
225	            }
226	            // Cursor after Background, before Shadow (road map creator-jobs CU3b, CU-38 (b)).
227	            if videoPane.allCursored { sections.append(videoPane.cursorSection()) }
228	            // Shadow is shared by all three drawing kinds, so it is here once.
229	            sections += [
230	                inspectorShadowSection(binding), videoPane.filtersSection(),
231	                videoPane.reflectionSection(), videoPane.spotlightSection(),
232	                videoPane.obscureSection(),
233	            ]
234	        case .color:
235	            // Light, then the Color section Picture used to hold (GR-2), then
236	            // Wheels (GR-11), Curves (GR-12), then Look (GR-7); Adjustment's
237	            // Strength first and the Qualifier second when every clip is an
238	            // adjustment clip (GR-6, GR-13).
239	            sections = [
240	                videoPane.lightSection(), videoPane.colorSection(), videoPane.wheelsSection(),
241	                videoPane.curvesSection(curveState),
242	            ]
243	            if videoPane.allAdjustment { sections.insert(videoPane.adjustmentSection(), at: 0) }
244	            if videoPane.allAdjustment { sections.insert(videoPane.qualifierSection(), at: 1) }
245	            sections.append(videoPane.lookSection(lookGallery))
246	        case .sound:
247	            sections = [
248	                audioPane.volumeSection(), audioPane.fadeSection(), audioPane.duckSection(),
249	                // The chain's head, in signal order (spec §11 AU-54, AU-38).
250	                audioPane.isolationSection(), audioPane.voiceSection(),
251	                audioPane.channelsSection(),
252	                audioPane.eqSection(), audioPane.humSection(),
253	                audioPane.noiseSection(), audioPane.gateSection(), audioPane.levellerSection(),
254	                audioPane.deEsserSection(),
255	                audioPane.compressorSection(), audioPane.mixSection(),
256	                // Last in the clip's chain, so last here (spec §11 AU-26).
257	                audioPane.limiterSection(),
258	            ]
259	        case .clip:
260	            if binding.isSingle, let clip = binding.primary {
261	                sections.append(timingSection(clip.id))
262	            } else if videoPane.allMedia {
263	                // The half of Timing a MULTI-clip selection can still answer
264	                // for: Reverse is a per-clip op that fans out happily, where
265	                // In, Out and Duration genuinely need one clip.
266	                sections.append(reverseTimingSection())
267	            }
268	            if videoPane.allMedia {
269	                sections.append(videoPane.speedSection())
270	            }
271	            if binding.isSingle, let clip = binding.primary,
272	               videoPane.overlap(before: clip) != nil {
273	                sections.append(videoPane.transitionSection(clip.id))
274	            }
275	            if hasPixels {
276	                sections.append(videoPane.motionSection())
277	            }
278	        }
279	        // A tab that would open as a column of shut headers opens its first
280	        // section with no stored preference instead. `expandByDefault` defers
281	        // to a section the user has closed themselves, so this is a default
282	        // and not an override — and it is offered to each section in TURN
283	        // because an id can be shared (`video.speed`, `clip.timing`), and a
284	        // group closed once elsewhere would otherwise leave the tab shut.
285	        if !sections.contains(where: { $0.isExpanded }) {
286	            for section in sections {
287	                if section.expandByDefault() { break }
288	            }
289	        }
290	        reveal.apply(sections, action: binding.selectedAction?.id, subTab: activeSubTab.rawValue)
291	        return sections
292	    }
293	}

2	// 10 §5j, G5a): Source (in `GraphicPane+Source.swift`), Properties from the
3	// module's schema (rows from `GraphicSchemaRows.swift`), Size and Timeline.
4	// With no action selected every write is `set_graphic`. With one selected, a
5	// Properties write — Reset's included — goes to the action's END with the
6	// module's current schema, one `set_action_end` naming `graphic.props.<key>`,
7	// except an `animate: false` prop's, which stays the clip's (spec §11 G-34
8	// (l), G-41 (d), G-42 (d)); Size and
9	// Timeline still write `set_graphic`, so their rows are ⊘. The core
10	// validates both.
11	//
12	// **Never shown itself**: like `ShapePane`, a factory `ClipPane` holds and
13	// calls when EVERY selected clip is a graphic clip.
14	//
15	// **Several graphic clips.** Source and Size always; Properties only when
16	// every clip is drawn by ONE module (one schema to build rows from, and the
17	// schema `set_graphic` needs), and Timeline only for one clip — its `in`
18	// and `length` are that clip's own. With different modules Source says so
19	// and names them (spec §11 G-15).

21	// **The schema is the registry's** (`GraphicRegistry.entry(named:for:)`,
22	// main only), the same read `AgentServer+Graphics.compiledModule` makes for
23	// the tool path. Nothing here rescans the store from an observer: `drain()`
24	// is not re-entrant (road map 10 §10.6 G3a).

28	extension InspectorBinding {
29	    /// The selected clips drawn by a module.
30	    var graphicClips: [ClipSnapshot] {
31	        clips.filter { clip in
32	            if case .graphic = clip.source { return clip.graphic != nil }

38	final class GraphicPane: InspectorPaneView {
39	    /// The report of each module/revision/library/frame hash/size seen, and
40	    /// the last report per clip — what a miss answers while a live gesture
41	    /// runs, so the signature holds still through a drag.
42	    var reportMemo: [String: GraphicClipReport] = [:]
43	    var lastReports: [UInt32: GraphicClipReport] = [:]
44	    /// The parsed schema of the last module asked, keyed "name|revision".
45	    var schemaMemo: (key: String, schema: GraphicSchema)?
46	    /// Each clip's recipe layer source under `layerProject`, the handle it
47	    /// was read from; emptied when the binding's project is another handle.
48	    weak var layerProject: ReelProject?
49	    var layerMemo: [UInt32: RecipeSourceRef] = [:]
50	
51	    /// Whether the graphic sections apply: they write `set_graphic`, which
52	    /// errors on any other kind, so a mixed selection gets none of them.
53	    var allGraphic: Bool {
54	        !binding.clips.isEmpty && binding.graphicClips.count == binding.clips.count
55	    }
56	
57	    /// The one module every selected graphic clip is drawn by.
58	    struct Shared {
59	        let name: String
60	        let file: GraphicModuleFile?
61	        let entry: GraphicRegistry.Entry?
62	    }
63	
64	    /// nil when the selection's modules differ (or it holds no graphic).
65	    func shared() -> Shared? {
66	        let names = Set(binding.graphicClips.compactMap { $0.graphic?.name })
67	        guard names.count == 1, let name = names.first else { return nil }
68	        let document = binding.document
69	        return Shared(
70	            name: name, file: document?.graphicStore?.module(named: name),
71	            entry: document.flatMap {
72	                GraphicRegistry.shared.entry(named: name, for: $0.recipeKey)
73	            })
74	    }
75	
76	    /// The compiled schema of `shared`, parsed in the module's order, and
77	    /// the registry's dictionary the ops carry. Parsed once per name and
78	    /// revision (`schemaMemo`).
79	    func schema(_ shared: Shared?) -> (schema: GraphicSchema, raw: [String: Any])? {
80	        guard let shared, case .compiled(let module, let revision, _, let raw)? = shared.entry
81	        else { return nil }
82	        let key = "\(shared.name)|\(revision)"
83	        if let memo = schemaMemo, memo.key == key { return (memo.schema, raw) }
84	        let parsed = GraphicSchema(describeJSON: module.describeJSON(), schema: raw)
85	        schemaMemo = (key, parsed)
86	        return (parsed, raw)
87	    }
88	
89	    /// The selection's stored props, merged; the first clip holding a key wins.
90	    func storedProps() -> [String: GraphicPropValue] {
91	        var merged: [String: GraphicPropValue] = [:]
92	        for clip in binding.graphicClips {
93	            merged.merge(clip.graphic?.props ?? [:]) { first, _ in first }
94	        }
95	        return merged
96	    }
97	
98	    /// The selected action's end props (G-34 (a)); none with no action
99	    /// selected. Its keys the schema lacks are the action's stale rows.
100	    func endProps() -> [String: GraphicPropValue] {
101	        binding.selectedAction?.end.graphic?.props ?? [:]
102	    }
103	
104	    /// The asset folder's file names, sorted.
105	    func assetNames() -> [String] {
106	        (binding.document?.graphicStore?.scan.assets.map(\.name) ?? []).sorted()
107	    }
108	
109	    /// What the graphics folder's scan skipped or could not watch, in its own
110	    /// sentences — the Source section's folder rows (G-24 (b)).
111	    func folderWarnings() -> [String] {
112	        binding.document?.graphicStore?.scan.warnings ?? []
113	    }
114	
115	    /// The schema's entries whole (a default, bounds or options a row is
116	    /// built from), the stale keys (the clip's, then the selected action's
117	    /// end's, `actionStaleKeys`, a declared key no action may animate
118	    /// included, G-41), each asset popup's names (the selected end's
119	    /// included, G-42), the
120	    /// diagnostics' messages and the folder's warnings. Stored values, the
121	    /// revision and the playhead are NOT here: they are read fresh by
122	    /// `refresh()`.
123	    override var structureSignature: String {
124	        guard allGraphic else { return super.structureSignature + "|-" }
125	        let shared = self.shared()
126	        let parsed = schema(shared)
127	        let keys = parsed?.schema.entries.map { String(describing: $0) } ?? []
128	        let stale = GraphicSchemaRows.staleKeys(stored: storedProps(), schema: parsed?.schema)
129	        var messages = ["-", "-"]
130	        if let shared, let clip = binding.graphicClips.first, let document = binding.document {
131	            let version = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey)?.libraryVersion
132	            let report = self.report(for: clip, shared, libraryVersion: version ?? "")
133	            func spell(_ list: [GraphicDiagnostic]) -> String {
134	                list.map { "\($0.level):\($0.line ?? -1):\($0.column ?? -1):\($0.message)" }
135	                    .joined(separator: "¶")
136	            }
137	            messages = [spell(report.compile), spell(report.render)]
138	        }
139	        messages.append(folderWarnings().joined(separator: "¶"))
140	        return [
141	            super.structureSignature, shared?.name ?? "mixed", keys.joined(separator: ","),
142	            stale.joined(separator: ","), assetSignature(parsed?.schema),
143	            GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleKeys(end: endProps(), schema: parsed?.schema)
144	                .joined(separator: ","),
145	        ].joined(separator: "|") + "|" + messages.joined(separator: "|")
146	    }
147	
148	    /// Each asset entry's popup names, from the rows' own
149	    /// `GraphicSchemaRows.assetNames` call, the selected action's end's names
150	    /// counting (G-42 (d)): names joined by ",", entries by ";".
151	    private func assetSignature(_ schema: GraphicSchema?) -> String {
152	        let files = assetNames(), clips = binding.graphicClips
153	        return (schema?.entries ?? []).filter { $0.type == "asset" }.map {
154	            GraphicSchemaRows.assetNames(for: $0, files: files, clips: clips, end: endProps())
155	                .joined(separator: ",")
156	        }.joined(separator: ";")
157	    }

159	    // MARK: - Properties
160	
161	    /// One row per schema key in the module's order, then the stale keys,
162	    /// sorted, then — with an action selected — the end's own stale keys
163	    /// (G-34 (l), O2), a declared key whose entry is not `animatable` among
164	    /// them (G-41 (c)). With no compiled schema every stored key is stale.
165	    /// Reset nulls every stored key; with an action selected it writes each
166	    /// declared default through the rows' own split, into the END (an
167	    /// asset's `null` as `""`, G-42 (d)), an `animate: false` prop's (G-41
168	    /// (d)) onto the clip (O7). Its `differs` folds from the rows.
169	    func propertiesSection() -> InspectorSection {
170	        let binding = self.binding
171	        let shared = self.shared()
172	        let parsed = schema(shared)
173	        let clips = { binding.graphicClips }
174	        let assets = { [weak self] in self?.assetNames() ?? [] }
175	        var rows: [NSView] = parsed?.schema.entries.map {
176	            GraphicSchemaRows.row(
177	                $0, binding, clips: clips, schema: parsed?.raw ?? [:], assets: assets)
178	        } ?? []
179	        let stored = storedProps()
180	        for key in GraphicSchemaRows.staleKeys(stored: stored, schema: parsed?.schema) {
181	            rows.append(
182	                GraphicSchemaRows.staleRow(
183	                    key: key, value: stored[key] ?? .null, binding, clips: clips))
184	        }
185	        let ends = endProps()
186	        let declared = Set(parsed?.schema.keys ?? [])
187	        for key in GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleKeys(end: ends, schema: parsed?.schema) {
188	            rows.append(
189	                GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleRow(
190	                    key: key, value: ends[key] ?? .null, declared: declared.contains(key), binding))
191	        }
192	        let note: String?
193	        if parsed == nil {
194	            note = "The module did not compile — see Source. Stored values are listed below."

140	    /// The module's compile, and `clip`'s first frame drawn and rasterized at
141	    /// the clip's own size — through the memo, and never recomputed while a
142	    /// live gesture runs.
143	    func report(
144	        for clip: ClipSnapshot, _ shared: Shared, libraryVersion: String
145	    ) -> GraphicClipReport {
146	        let module: GraphicModule, revision: String
147	        switch shared.entry {
148	        case nil:
149	            return GraphicClipReport(
150	                compile: [GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(shared.name)],
151	                render: [], frame: nil)
152	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _)?:
153	            return GraphicClipReport(compile: diagnostics, render: [], frame: nil)
154	        case .compiled(let compiled, let hash, _, _)?:
155	            module = compiled
156	            revision = hash
157	        }
158	        guard let graphic = clip.graphic, let document = binding.document else { return .empty }
159	        if document.isLiveEditing { return lastReports[clip.id] ?? .empty }
160	        guard let set = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey),
161	              let source = layerSource(of: clip),
162	              case .graphic(_, let hash, let frame, let propsJSON, let ctxJSON) = source
163	        else { return .empty }
164	        let key = [
165	            shared.name, revision, libraryVersion, hash, "\(graphic.width)×\(graphic.height)",
166	        ].joined(separator: "|")
167	        if let hit = reportMemo[key] {
168	            lastReports[clip.id] = hit
169	            return hit
170	        }
171	        var render: [GraphicDiagnostic] = []
172	        do {
173	            let drawn = try module.svg(
174	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
175	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs)
176	            render += drawn.warnings
177	            do {
178	                let raster = try set.library.rasterize(
179	                    drawn.svg, width: graphic.width, height: graphic.height)
180	                render += raster.warnings
181	            } catch {
182	                render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
183	            }
184	        } catch {
185	            render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
186	        }
187	        let report = GraphicClipReport(
188	            compile: module.compileWarnings, render: render, frame: frame)
189	        if reportMemo.count >= 64 { reportMemo.removeAll() }
190	        reportMemo[key] = report
191	        lastReports[clip.id] = report
192	        return report
193	    }

195	    /// `clip`'s layer source in the recipe at its start, through
196	    /// `layerMemo`: `recipe(at:)` is asked only on a miss, and the memo is
197	    /// emptied when the binding's project is another handle.
198	    func layerSource(of clip: ClipSnapshot) -> RecipeSourceRef? {
199	        guard let project = binding.project else { return nil }
200	        if project !== layerProject {
201	            layerMemo = [:]
202	            layerProject = project
203	        }
204	        if let hit = layerMemo[clip.id] { return hit }
205	        guard let layer = project.recipe(at: clip.start)?.layers
206	            .first(where: { $0.clip == clip.id })
207	        else { return nil }
208	        layerMemo[clip.id] = layer.source
209	        return layer.source
210	    }

212	    /// Copies the module's file under a new name the person types, then
213	    /// repoints the selected clips at it with `set_graphic {name}` — the

215	    /// `write_graphic` of the source under the new name, then `set_graphic`.
216	    func duplicateAsNewGraphic(_ file: GraphicModuleFile, schema: [String: Any]?) {
217	        guard let store = binding.document?.graphicStore else { return NSSound.beep() }
218	        let suggestion = store.uniqueModuleName(file.name + "-copy")
219	        let alert = NSAlert()
220	        alert.alertStyle = .informational
221	        alert.messageText = "Duplicate \(file.name).js as a new graphic"
222	        alert.informativeText =
223	            "The copy is written into the package's graphics/ folder and the selected clips "
224	            + "are drawn by it. Writing the file cannot be undone; switching the clips can."
225	        let field = NSTextField(string: suggestion)
226	        field.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 240, height: 24)
227	        field.placeholderString = "Module name"
228	        alert.accessoryView = field
229	        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Duplicate")
230	        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
231	        alert.window.initialFirstResponder = field
232	        guard alert.runModal() == .alertFirstButtonReturn else { return }
233	        let name = field.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
234	        func refuse(_ sentence: String) {
235	            NSAlert(error: NSError(
236	                domain: "FrameJob", code: 1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: sentence]))
237	                .runModal()
238	        }
239	        guard GraphicStore.isModuleName(name) else { return refuse(GraphicStore.nameSentence(name)) }
240	        guard !store.holdsModule(named: name) else {
241	            return refuse("graphics/\(name).js already exists")

253	    }

1	// app/Sources/GraphicSchemaRows.swift — a graphic module's schema as the
2	// Graphic sub-tab's Properties rows (road map 10 §5j, G5a): the schema read
3	// in the MODULE's key order, one row per entry built with the inspector's
4	// existing builders, the stored keys the schema no longer has (G-4's
5	// leniency, made visible), and the two conversions a colour needs at the
6	// well's edge (G-12: a prop's colour is a CSS string, the well's is `RGBA`).
7	//
8	// **No state of its own.** Every function here is a function of its
9	// arguments, so a probe can drive each one without a window.
10	//
11	// **Where a write goes** (spec §11 G-34 (l)): with no action selected every
12	// row writes `set_graphic` to the clip; with one selected, a row reads the
13	// action's END state (`InspectorBinding.graphicProps`) and writes it — one
14	// `set_action_end` naming `graphic.props.<key>` with the module's schema —
15	// through `InspectorBinding.ops(graphic:…)`, an asset's included, its "no
16	// image" written as `""` there (G-42, `endValues`); only a prop its module
17	// marks `animate: false` (G-41) is still the clip's.
18	//
19	// **A value equal to the schema's default is written as `null`** to the
20	// clip (spec §11 G-15): the key leaves the stored props and the module
21	// draws its own default, which is exactly what Reset writes too. An end
22	// takes the value itself, since a `null` there removes (G-34 (j)). A colour is "equal" by
23	// its parsed channels, and a colour DEFAULT is read through the core's own
24	// G-12 (`ReelColor.normalise`, spec §11 G-25), so a name or `hsl()` default
25	// draws and matches as the colour it is; a default G-12 refuses does not
26	// compile (`model_graphic.rs`, the engine's `props.rs`).
27	
28	import AppKit
29	
30	enum GraphicSchemaRows {
31	    /// The swatch when a colour default is not a colour G-12 takes — which
32	    /// compile refuses, so only a schema no compile checked reaches it:
33	    /// transparent black.
34	    static let unparsedColor: RGBA = [0, 0, 0, 0]
35	
36	    /// A JSON value from `JSONSerialization` as a prop value.
37	    static func value(_ any: Any?) -> GraphicPropValue {
38	        if let string = any as? String { return .string(string) }
39	        if let number = any as? NSNumber {
40	            return CFGetTypeID(number) == CFBooleanGetTypeID()
41	                ? .bool(number.boolValue) : .number(number.doubleValue)
42	        }
43	        return .null
44	    }
45	
46	    /// A prop value as the JSON a patch carries.
47	    static func json(_ value: GraphicPropValue) -> Any {
48	        switch value {
49	        case .string(let string): return string
50	        case .number(let number): return number
51	        case .bool(let bool): return bool
52	        case .null: return NSNull()
53	        }
54	    }
55	
56	    /// `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`, any case, as channels 0–1.
57	    static func rgba(css: String) -> RGBA? {
58	        let text = css.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
59	        guard text.hasPrefix("#") else { return nil }
60	        let hex = Array(text.dropFirst())
61	        guard [3, 4, 6, 8].contains(hex.count), hex.allSatisfy(\.isHexDigit) else { return nil }
62	        let pairs: [String] = hex.count <= 4
63	            ? hex.map { String([$0, $0]) }
64	            : stride(from: 0, to: hex.count, by: 2).map { String(hex[$0..<$0 + 2]) }
65	        var channels = pairs.map { Double(UInt8($0, radix: 16) ?? 0) / 255 }
66	        if channels.count == 3 { channels.append(1) }
67	        return channels
68	    }
69	
70	    /// `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` when the alpha is below 1 — the core's own
71	    /// normalised form, lowercase.
72	    static func css(_ color: RGBA) -> String {
73	        let channels = (0..<4).map { index -> Int in
74	            let value = color.indices.contains(index) ? color[index] : 1
75	            return Int((Swift.min(Swift.max(value, 0), 1) * 255).rounded())
76	        }
77	        let rgb = channels[0..<3].map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
78	        return "#" + rgb + (channels[3] == 255 ? "" : String(format: "%02x", channels[3]))
79	    }
80

83	        if case .string(let text) = entry.default, let hex = ReelColor.normalise(text),

90	    /// What a write sends for `value`: `null` when it equals the default,
91	    /// else the value itself.
92	    static func patchValue(_ value: GraphicPropValue, for entry: GraphicSchemaEntry) -> Any {
93	        if entry.type == "color" {
94	            if case .string(let text) = value, rgba(css: text) == defaultColor(entry) {
95	                return NSNull()
96	            }

98	            return NSNull()

103	    /// A base write's props: each value through `patchValue` against its
104	    /// entry, and a key no entry declares as it is.
105	    static func patchProps(
106	        _ values: [String: GraphicPropValue], entries: [GraphicSchemaEntry]
107	    ) -> [String: Any] {
108	        var props: [String: Any] = [:]
109	        for (key, value) in values {
110	            if let entry = entries.first(where: { $0.key == key }) {
111	                props[key] = patchValue(value, for: entry)
112	            } else {
113	                props[key] = json(value)
114	            }
115	        }
116	        return props

119	    /// The stored keys `schema` does not declare, sorted — all of them when
120	    /// there is no compiled schema.
121	    static func staleKeys(stored: [String: GraphicPropValue], schema: GraphicSchema?) -> [String] {
122	        let declared = Set(schema?.keys ?? [])
123	        return stored.keys.filter { !declared.contains($0) }.sorted()

126	    /// The keys the selected action's END names that no row writes into it,
127	    /// sorted: each `schema` does not declare and each whose entry is not
128	    /// `animatable` (G-41 (c)); every key with no compiled schema. The
129	    /// undeclared keys are `staleKeys`' own.

131	        let held = Set((schema?.entries ?? []).filter { !$0.animatable }.map(\.key))
132	        let declaredHeld = end.keys.filter { held.contains($0) }

136	    /// A number row's decimals: with a `step`, 2 below 1 and else 0; with
137	    /// none, 2 when the default, `min` or `max` has a fraction, else 0.
138	    static func decimals(for entry: GraphicSchemaEntry) -> Int {
139	        if let step = entry.step { return step < 1 ? 2 : 0 }
140	        var values = [entry.min, entry.max].compactMap { $0 }
141	        if case .number(let number) = entry.default { values.append(number) }
142	        return values.contains { $0 != $0.rounded() } ? 2 : 0

145	    /// An end write's props: each value as it is, except an `asset` entry's `.null`, which is
146	    /// `.string("")` — "no image" in an end, where a `null` removes (spec §11 G-42).
147	    static func endValues(
148	        _ values: [String: GraphicPropValue], entries: [GraphicSchemaEntry]
149	    ) -> [String: GraphicPropValue] {
150	        var out: [String: GraphicPropValue] = [:]
151	        for (key, value) in values {
152	            guard let entry = entries.first(where: { $0.key == key }) else {
153	                out[key] = value
154	                continue
155	            }
156	            out[key] = entry.type == "asset" && value == .null ? .string("") : value
157	        }
158	        return out

161	    /// An asset entry's popup names: the folder's `files`, then, sorted,
162	    /// every name a clip holds under `entry.key`, the selected action's
163	    /// `end` holds, and a string default, that `files` lacks. A `""` is no
164	    /// image ("None", G-42) and never a name. The rows and the pane's
165	    /// signature both call this.
166	    static func assetNames(
167	        for entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, files: [String], clips: [ClipSnapshot],
168	        end: [String: GraphicPropValue]
169	    ) -> [String] {
170	        var held = clips.compactMap { clip -> String? in
171	            if case .string(let text)? = clip.graphic?.props[entry.key], !text.isEmpty { return text }
172	            return nil
173	        }
174	        if case .string(let text)? = end[entry.key], !text.isEmpty { held.append(text) }
175	        if case .string(let text) = entry.default, !text.isEmpty { held.append(text) }
176	        return files + Set(held).subtracting(files).sorted()
177	    }

186	    /// One schema entry's row. Every `read` answers the default in the
187	    /// binding's `.defaults` mode, so the builders' derived Reset works, and
188	    /// otherwise the binding's mode's value (the selected action's end, its
189	    /// start, the playhead); every write is `InspectorBinding.ops(graphic:…)`
190	    /// over `clips()`.
191	    static func row(
192	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding,
193	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], schema: [String: Any],
194	        assets: @escaping () -> [String]
195	    ) -> NSView {
196	        let key = entry.key, name = "Graphic " + entry.label
197	        func stored() -> GraphicPropValue? {
198	            clips().first.map { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } ?? nil
199	        }
200	        func current() -> GraphicPropValue { stored() ?? entry.default }
201	        func ops(_ value: GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp] {
202	            binding.ops(graphic: value, for: entry, clips: clips(), schema: schema)
203	        }
204	        let mixed = { binding.mixed(clips()) { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } }
205	        let view: NSView
206	        switch entry.type {
207	        case "number":
208	            let fallback: Double = {
209	                if case .number(let number) = entry.default { return number }
210	                return 0
211	            }()
212	            let bounded = entry.min != nil && entry.max != nil
213	            view = inspectorValueRow(
214	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
215	                decimals: decimals(for: entry),
216	                min: entry.min ?? -1e9, max: entry.max ?? 1e9, slider: bounded,
217	                read: {
218	                    if case .number(let number) = current() { return number }
219	                    return fallback
220	                },
221	                ops: { ops(.number($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
222	        case "boolean":
223	            view = inspectorCheckRow(
224	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
225	                read: {
226	                    if case .bool(let bool) = current() { return bool }
227	                    if case .bool(let bool) = entry.default { return bool }
228	                    return false
229	                },
230	                ops: { ops(.bool($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
231	        case "color":
232	            view = inspectorColorRow(
233	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
234	                read: {
235	                    if case .string(let text)? = stored(), let color = rgba(css: text) {
236	                        return color
237	                    }
238	                    return defaultColor(entry)
239	                },
240	                ops: { ops(.string(css($0))) }, mixed: mixed)
241	        case "enum":
242	            let options = entry.options
243	            view = inspectorPopupRow(
244	                entry.label, binding, name: name, items: options,
245	                read: {
246	                    if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = options.firstIndex(of: text) {
247	                        return index
248	                    }
249	                    if case .string(let text) = entry.default,
250	                       let index = options.firstIndex(of: text)
251	                    {
252	                        return index
253	                    }
254	                    return 0
255	                },
256	                ops: { index in options.indices.contains(index) ? ops(.string(options[index])) : [] },
257	                mixed: mixed)
258	        case "asset":
259	            view = assetRow(entry, binding, name: name, clips: clips, assets: assets,
260	                            current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
261	        case "string":
262	            view = stringRow(entry, binding, name: name, current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
263	        default:
264	            view = inspectorRow(
265	                entry.label, [inspectorReadout { "type \"\(entry.type)\" is not supported" }])
266	        }

268	        return view

271	    /// The asset popup: "None" first on every asset row (G-42 (d)), the
272	    /// folder's files, then any name a clip or the selected action's end
273	    /// holds (or the default names) that the folder does not. A `""`, a
274	    /// `null` or an unknown value reads as "None". "None" writes `null` at
275	    /// the base when the default is `null` and `""` when it is a string; an
276	    /// end takes `""` either way (`endValues`).
277	    private static func assetRow(
278	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding, name: String,
279	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], assets: @escaping () -> [String],
280	        current: @escaping () -> GraphicPropValue,
281	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
282	    ) -> NSView {
283	        let names = assetNames(
284	            for: entry, files: assets(), clips: clips(),
285	            end: binding.selectedAction?.end.graphic?.props ?? [:])
286	        let items = ["None"] + names
287	        let offset = 1
288	        return inspectorPopupRow(
289	            entry.label, binding, name: name, items: items,
290	            read: {
291	                if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = names.firstIndex(of: text) {
292	                    return index + offset
293	                }
294	                return 0
295	            },
296	            ops: { index in
297	                if index == 0 { return ops(entry.default == .null ? .null : .string("")) }

304	    /// A string entry: a one-line field, or a text area when `multiline`.

310	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
311	    ) -> NSView {
312	        let read: () -> String = {
313	            if case .string(let text) = current() { return text }
314	            return ""
315	        }

319	                read: read, write: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply(name, write($0)) },

351	    /// declares (G-34 (l), O2), or `declared` but not `animatable` (G-41 (c)):

355	        key: String, value: GraphicPropValue, declared: Bool, _ binding: InspectorBinding
356	    ) -> NSView {

359	        let remove = OptionButtonControl(
360	            title: "⌫",
361	            action: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply("Remove from Action", ops) },
362	            enabled: { true }, onEdit: {})
363	        let number = binding.selectedActionNumber.map { String($0) } ?? ""
364	        remove.toolTip = declared
365	            ? "The module does not let \(key) be animated — remove it from action \(number)"

370	    /// A stale row's key, dimmed, and its value.
371	    private static func staleLabels(
372	        key: String, value: GraphicPropValue
373	    ) -> (InspectorRowLabel, NSView) {
374	        let label = InspectorRowLabel(key)
375	        label.textColor = DS.textFaint
376	        label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
377	        label.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: InspectorMetrics.labelWidth).isActive = true
378	        let shown: String
379	        switch value {
380	        case .string(let text): shown = "\"\(text)\""
381	        case .number(let number): shown = String(format: "%g", number)
382	        case .bool(let bool): shown = bool ? "true" : "false"
383	        case .null: shown = "null"

1	// app/Sources/GraphicSchema.swift — a graphic module's schema as the
2	// Graphic sub-tab reads it (road map 10 §5j, G5a): one entry per key, in the
3	// MODULE's key order. A pure move out of `GraphicSchemaRows.swift`.
4	
5	import Foundation
6	
7	/// One schema entry, as `describe` published it.
8	struct GraphicSchemaEntry: Equatable {
9	    let key: String, type: String, `default`: GraphicPropValue, label: String, help: String?
10	    let min: Double?, max: Double?, step: Double?, multiline: Bool, options: [String]
11	    /// The module's `animate` (spec §11 G-41); absent is true.
12	    var animate: Bool = true
13	    /// Whether an action's end may name this prop: the one test the
14	    /// inspector's split and the end's stale rows use. An asset is
15	    /// animatable, switching at the end (G-42); only `animate: false` is not.
16	    var animatable: Bool { animate }
17	}
18	
19	/// A module's schema, in the module's own key order.
20	struct GraphicSchema: Equatable {
21	    let entries: [GraphicSchemaEntry]
22	
23	    var keys: [String] { entries.map(\.key) }
24	
25	    /// The order from `describeJSON`'s text, the values from `schema` (the
26	    /// registry's parse, which lost the order through `JSONSerialization`).
27	    /// A key the dictionary lacks is dropped; a dictionary key the text
28	    /// lacks is appended, sorted.
29	    init(describeJSON: String, schema: [String: Any]) {
30	        var seen = Set<String>()
31	        var order: [String] = []
32	        for key in Self.orderedKeys(describeJSON: describeJSON)
33	        where schema[key] != nil && !seen.contains(key) {
34	            seen.insert(key)
35	            order.append(key)
36	        }
37	        order += schema.keys.filter { !seen.contains($0) }.sorted()
38	        entries = order.map { key in
39	            let entry = schema[key] as? [String: Any] ?? [:]
40	            func number(_ name: String) -> Double? {
41	                guard let value = entry[name] as? NSNumber,
42	                      CFGetTypeID(value) != CFBooleanGetTypeID()
43	                else { return nil }
44	                return value.doubleValue
45	            }
46	            return GraphicSchemaEntry(
47	                key: key, type: entry["type"] as? String ?? "",
48	                default: GraphicSchemaRows.value(entry["default"]),
49	                label: entry["label"] as? String ?? key, help: entry["help"] as? String,
50	                min: number("min"), max: number("max"), step: number("step"),
51	                multiline: (entry["multiline"] as? NSNumber)?.boolValue ?? false,
52	                options: entry["options"] as? [String] ?? [],
53	                animate: (entry["animate"] as? NSNumber)?.boolValue ?? true)
54	        }
55	    }
56	
57	    /// The keys of the top-level `"schema"` object in `describe`'s JSON
58	    /// text, in the order the text has them — the core serialises with
59	    /// `preserve_order`. A scanner rather than a parser: string state with
60	    /// `\` escapes, a stack of `{` and `[`, and a key is a string followed
61	    /// by `:` directly inside an object.
62	    static func orderedKeys(describeJSON text: String) -> [String] {
63	        let bytes = Array(text.utf8)
64	        let quote = UInt8(ascii: "\""), backslash = UInt8(ascii: "\\")
65	        let colon = UInt8(ascii: ":"), comma = UInt8(ascii: ",")
66	        let openBrace = UInt8(ascii: "{"), closeBrace = UInt8(ascii: "}")
67	        let openBracket = UInt8(ascii: "["), closeBracket = UInt8(ascii: "]")
68	        var stack: [UInt8] = []
69	        var lastString: [UInt8]?
70	        var armed = false  // the top-level key just read is "schema"
71	        var inSchema = false  // inside the schema's own object (depth 2)
72	        var keys: [String] = []
73	        var i = 0
74	        while i < bytes.count {
75	            let byte = bytes[i]
76	            if byte == quote {
77	                var j = i + 1
78	                var string: [UInt8] = []
79	                while j < bytes.count, bytes[j] != quote {
80	                    if bytes[j] == backslash, j + 1 < bytes.count {
81	                        string.append(bytes[j])
82	                        j += 1
83	                    }
84	                    string.append(bytes[j])
85	                    j += 1
86	                }
87	                lastString = string
88	                i = j + 1
89	                continue
90	            }
91	            switch byte {
92	            case colon:
93	                if stack.last == openBrace, let string = lastString {
94	                    let key = String(decoding: string, as: UTF8.self)
95	                    if stack.count == 1 {
96	                        armed = key == "schema"
97	                    } else if inSchema, stack.count == 2 {
98	                        keys.append(key)
99	                    }
100	                }
101	                lastString = nil
102	            case openBrace, openBracket:
103	                if armed, stack.count == 1, byte == openBrace { inSchema = true }
104	                armed = false
105	                stack.append(byte)
106	            case closeBrace, closeBracket:
107	                _ = stack.popLast()
108	                if stack.count < 2 { inSchema = false }
109	            case comma:
110	                lastString = nil
111	                if stack.count == 1 { armed = false }
112	            default:
113	                break
114	            }
115	            i += 1
116	        }
117	        return keys
118	    }
119	}

3	/// One sub-tab of the Clip tab (spec §11 CI-5). The case order is the display
4	/// order: Text and Shape come first for those kinds, Clip is always last.
5	enum ClipSubTab: String, CaseIterable {
6	    case text, shape, graphic, picture, color, sound, clip
7	
8	    var title: String {
9	        switch self {
10	        case .text: return "Text"
11	        case .shape: return "Shape"
12	        case .graphic: return "Graphic"
13	        case .picture: return "Picture"
14	        case .color: return "Color"
15	        case .sound: return "Sound"
16	        case .clip: return "Clip"
17	        }
18	    }
19	
20	    /// The `◆N` badge (spec §11 CI-6): how many KEYS of an action's end patch
21	    /// this tab's sections write. Motion lives on Clip, so Picture counts the
22	    /// video keys without it; a shape's props are not animatable; Graphic
23	    /// counts the end's `graphic.props`, a key its module no longer declares
24	    /// included (CI-6 amended, G-34 (l)). Color counts `color`, one key
25	    /// however many of its thirteen the end names, and Picture no longer does
26	    /// (CI-6 amended by GR-2); for an all-adjustment selection (`adjustment`)
27	    /// it also counts `opacity`, the Adjustment section's Strength (GR-6). An
28	    /// end's `look` is Color's too, one key (GR-7), and so is its `wheels`,
29	    /// one key however many of its nine it names (GR-11), and its `curves`,
30	    /// one key however many channels it names (GR-12), and its `qualifier`,
31	    /// one key however many ranges it names (GR-13); Picture counts none of
32	    /// them. Clip also counts an end's `speed`, the Speed section's Rate (CI-6
33	    /// amended by SR-21).
34	    func keyedCount(in end: ActionPatch, adjustment: Bool = false) -> Int {
35	        switch self {
36	        case .text: return end.text?.dictionary.count ?? 0
37	        case .shape: return 0
38	        case .graphic: return end.graphic?.props.count ?? 0
39	        case .picture:
40	            let other: Set<String> = ["motion", "color", "look", "wheels", "curves", "qualifier"]
41	            return end.video?.dictionary.keys.filter { !other.contains($0) }.count ?? 0
42	        case .color:
43	            return (end.video?.color?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
44	                + (end.video?.dictionary["look"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
45	                + (end.video?.wheels?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
46	                + (end.video?.curves?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
47	                + (end.video?.qualifier?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
48	                + (adjustment && end.video?.dictionary["opacity"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
49	        case .sound: return end.audio?.dictionary.count ?? 0
50	        case .clip:
51	            return (end.video?.dictionary["motion"] == nil ? 0 : 1) + (end.speed == nil ? 0 : 1)
52	        }
53	    }
54	}

56	/// The strip of sub-tabs under the action lane: equal square cells whose 1 pt

58	/// accent border, and a mint `◆N` after a label whose tab the selected action
59	/// keys. Built with its tabs and its active one, like `PanelTabsView`: a pick

67	    let active: ClipSubTab

74	        onSelect: @escaping (ClipSubTab) -> Void

85	    @available(*, unavailable)

90	    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }

96	    /// Equal cells, each sharing its left border with the previous one's

100	        let step = (bounds.width - 2 * Self.side - 1) / CGFloat(max(tabs.count, 1))
101	        let left = Self.side + (CGFloat(index) * step).rounded()
102	        let right = Self.side + (CGFloat(index + 1) * step).rounded() + 1
103	        return CGRect(x: left, y: Self.top, width: right - left, height: Self.cell)
104	    }

108	        let next = tabs.map(badge)

42:To stop animating a property, take it out of the action. See [Set what an action animates to](/motion/edit-an-action/#take-a-property-out-of-the-action).
55:A module that needs whole numbers has to round them itself, or mark the property [`animate: false`](#stop-a-property-animating). One that does neither can fail on a fraction. Those frames draw the error card, and an export stops there.
64:## Where an animated property starts
70:Resetting the clip's own value for a property an action animates sets it to the default, so the action still has somewhere to start from.
74:A module can mark any property with `animate: false`, and no action will ever animate it. Modules use this for a count, a layout mode or a data series, where a value part way between two others would break the drawing.
82:  count: { type: "number", default: 5, min: 1, max: 20, step: 1, animate: false },
90:Each value in an action is checked against the module as it is now, including any minimum and maximum. That has a few effects when the module changes after you've animated it:
93:- If an action names a property the module no longer declares, or no longer lets animate, the row shows dimmed with **⌫**. Choose it to take the property out of the action.
98:The **Graphic** sub-tab shows a **◆N** badge counting how many properties the selected action animates. The **Properties** section header shows the same count. See [Read the sections and sub-tabs](/motion/edit-an-action/#read-the-sections-and-sub-tabs).
100:On the timeline, an action's band names a graphic's animated properties along with anything else the action changes, when the track is tall enough to show the label.
104:An agent works the same way, adding an action and then naming the end values with `set_action_end`. It can't set a value on a property marked `animate: false` that way, and sets it on the clip with `set_graphic` instead. See [Tools: animation](/mcp/tools-animation/).
109:- [Set what an action animates to](/motion/edit-an-action/)

content.content:
the lists says "Exporting <title>…", then "Exported <title> to <file>: …"
with the files it holds, or why it could not. Saving over a file replaces it.
Exporting changes nothing in the project and is not an undo step.

To find which fonts and pictures belong in the package, Frame Job draws the
graphic: every frame (up to 900; a longer graphic has 900 frames spread over
it) with its default properties, then each choice of each `enum` property
and the other value of each `boolean` property, one at a time, over 30
frames each (at most 32 of these). A font is packed when the graphic drew or
measured text with it, or fell back to it for a character its own font
lacks; a picture when an `asset(name)` drew it. The app's own fonts are
never packed, since every copy of Frame Job has them. Text and pictures a
graphic only uses for property values other than the defaults (a different
title, another picture) are not looked for. A frame that fails is skipped.

- **In the graphics folder**: files the folder scan skipped (a bad module or
  picture name, an empty file, a font that loads no face) or could not watch,
